title: Public Business Source Ledger (PASS 43)
notice: Internal source ledger. Real public sources used only to CREATE anonymized, privacy-safe shadow fixtures. OpsIQ itself performs NO live fetch/scraping/connector; there is no live internet intelligence. Every item is a PUBLIC SIGNAL, not a confirmed fact. Real business names are NOT exposed in fixtures/cockpit — only anonymized BUSINESS_A/B/C. Reviewer/staff PII is redacted. Observations are category/theme-level to avoid defamation of any identifiable business.

items.publicObservation: Public complaint records for a laundry pickup/delivery service describe valet drivers arriving 1.5-2 hours late despite assured complimentary pickup windows.
items.redactedObservation: Public review signals suggest possible recurring pickup/delivery-delay complaints for a laundry pickup/delivery service (LOCATION_A).
items.privacyTreatment: No reviewer names/PII retained; business anonymized to BUSINESS_A; observation kept at theme level.
items.uncertainty: HIGH — third-party complaint text, not internally verified; volume/rate unknown.
items.reason: Operational delivery-delay theme OpsIQ can route to correction/validation (not accusation).

items.publicObservation: Public guidance summarising common dry-cleaning complaints: garment damage, shrinkage, discolouration, torn seams, and stains appearing after service.
items.redactedObservation: Public review signals suggest possible garment-quality/rework complaints (damage, discolouration, stains after service) in the dry-cleaning category.
items.privacyTreatment: Category-level theme; no business identified; no PII.
items.uncertainty: HIGH — category theme, not this business's measured defect rate.
items.reason: Quality/rework theme routes to a correction task with evidence gate; internal defect rate is missing-data.

items.publicObservation: Public reviews also praise some pickup/delivery cleaners for eco-friendly care and delivering ahead of promised dates.
items.redactedObservation: Public review signals also include positive praise (eco-friendly care, on-time/early delivery) for some pickup/delivery cleaners.
items.uncertainty: MODERATE — positive praise, not a risk signal.
items.reason: Positive signal → monitor-only unless an actionable risk exists; must not close unresolved risks.

items.publicObservation: UK public procurement portals list building/office cleaning tenders (e.g. a town-council cleaning contract with a submission deadline of 15 May 2026; a borough building-cleaning tender published 25 May 2026 with a 22 June 2026 deadline).
items.redactedObservation: A public cleaning-services tender opportunity exists for the cleaning/local-service category; the specific listed deadlines (May-June 2026) have already passed as of 2026-07-07.
items.privacyTreatment: Buyer authorities are public bodies; no personal names/contacts retained; anonymized reference only.
items.uncertainty: LOW on existence; the specific listed deadlines are expired.
items.reason: Growth/opportunity + tender-deadline signal; the specific deadline is STALE → readiness/monitor, never auto-submit.

items.privacyTreatment: Aggregate industry analysis; no business identified; no PII.
items.uncertainty: HIGH — aggregate category statistic, not this venue's measured wait time.
items.reason: Service-delay theme → process correction + reassessment; internal wait-time data is missing.

items.reason: DO_NOT_USE — PII + defamation risk; cannot be used as a governed signal.

items.publicObservation: Analysis of ~100k SaaS reviews: support complaints carry the highest churn-signal language (49% of negative reviews); pricing complaints second (41%); onboarding third but highest churn-per-mention (3.2x more likely to signal the reviewer has left/left-planning).
items.redactedObservation: Public review signals for a project-management SaaS (BUSINESS_C) suggest possible support-responsiveness, pricing, and onboarding-friction complaints.
items.privacyTreatment: Aggregate dataset; no reviewer PII; business anonymized.
items.uncertainty: HIGH — aggregate across many products, not this product's measured rate.
items.reason: Support/onboarding themes → correction/validation; pricing → owner decision (blocked until margin known).

items.redactedObservation: Public review signals suggest possible technical-bug and onboarding-difficulty complaints for a project-management SaaS.
items.uncertainty: HIGH — category theme, not this product.
